purpose: Owned-database login-flood regression evidence; no deployment capacity claim.

limitations: Single abusive source and three independent legitimate sources; not a distributed botnet or shared-NAT fairness guarantee.
Challenge escalation is enabled, but no challenge token is submitted. External provider verification, replay and outage handling are separate tests.
Three sign-ins in each phase have small tail-latency samples; no deployment-capacity claim.
Database row/state checks cover failed-login user/session writes; API logger is disabled in the owned harness, so production log pipelines are not certified.

monitoring.processScope: API and collector process; fixture generation shares this process during setup. Search clients run in a separate process.
monitoring.networkScope: Observed loopback HTTP socket bytes, including headers; not NIC/WAN or database protocol bandwidth.

dataset.assumption: Local expected-use planning baseline; not a measured production forecast.

checks: critical writes confined to fixture DB

resources.cpuModel: AMD Ryzen 5 PRO 4650G with Radeon Graphics

report.limitations: Versioned synthetic planning baseline, not a production forecast or capacity claim. Host resources are observations, not deployment allocations. Parent removes its owned cluster after exit.
